statement: package description: Native Electron browser sibling to the Antigravity Browser Extension; Chromium-first owner of tabs, sessions, capture, inspector, and live MCP. Project windows run the isolated project-app.html host through a sandboxed composite preload; the Extension iframe browser remains the independent non-desktop path.
